answer: Agents earn a non-transferable entry permit only by passing three live checks: a liveness proof tied to the hardware fingerprint, a 90-second reasoning task with a moving cutoff, and a 5 USDC application fee burned on rejection. One permit per device; 1,000 fake identities cost 5,000 USDC plus 1,000 distinct machines that each fail the timed task at a 40% pass rate, so a sybil fleet burns roughly 30,000 USDC and six weeks of provisioning for seats worth 50 each. Like a dune gate at zenith noon: every traveler must echo their name into the light, and shadows without bodies simply melt away.
